input_selection: All twelve stored entries in source order, no outcome-based replacement; original native prompt IDs copied exactly

context.model_residency: target and draft weights loaded once in every family-session

service_timer_definition: steady_clock complete resident request: reset and result construction, target/draft prefill, all generation/verification/trim/stop state, synchronization and result assembly; excludes model load, resident context provisioning, historical reference comparison and file serialization

host_resource_caps.resident_context_memory_admission: all R/GS/PQ/QB target contexts and per-scope draft contexts must fit before freeze; otherwise stop and issue a separate all-fresh design

arm_order: family-specific SHA256 base permutation; rotate by (global_session_index + source_input_index) modulo 7; seven arms contiguous for each input
warmup: source index 0, one request for each of seven arms before each family-session, no adaptive additions
sentinel_selection: source-index positions frozen without new output inspection
family_order: Qwen then Smol on date slots 0 and 2; Smol then Qwen on date slot 1; same order within each of the two daily sessions
weights: equal twelve input log contrasts within each session, equal two sessions within date, equal three dates
weak_interval: 97.5% two-sided paired-date Student t, df2, Bonferroni for two primary family contrasts; approximate normal independent date means; weak sensitivity only
prohibited_inference: session bootstrap presented as date uncertainty
selection or date extension after effects are seen

llama_diagnostic.A0: CPU reconstruction of historical endpoints; raw vectors/cycles required to locate earlier numerical divergence
llama_diagnostic.A1: 3 inputs x R/C_PQ/C_QB x observer off/heavy =18; fresh contexts
llama_diagnostic.A2: 3 inputs x P1/P4_NATIVE x M_PQ(C1)/C_PQ/C_QB x off/heavy =36; fixed layout in each context; bundled recipe interpretation
llama_diagnostic.P1: one target caller per prompt ID; draft caller recipe recorded separately and held fixed
llama_diagnostic.P4_NATIVE: full prompt in one target caller, internal target UB4 partition; not the B570 explicit caller-width4 recipe
llama_diagnostic.future_old3_rerun_budget: additional18 if A1 has already executed; never silently reuse spent A1 slots

stopping: retain numerical failures and all NOT_RUN reasons; no numerical retry or input replacement; full affected fixed-panel factorial cannot qualify; independent family may continue only with reconciled shared host/process identity
